act_title: The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
title: Provisions to be in addition to existing laws.–The provisions of this Act shall be in addition
text:
103. Provisions to be in addition to existing laws.–The provisions of this Act shall be in addition

to and not in derogation of, any other law for the time being in force.
